title: Understanding the Model
text: The model we are using is \( \hat{y}=\hat{\theta}_1x_1+\hat{\theta}_2x_1**{2} \). This is a polynomial regression model where \( $$x_1$$ \) is critic 1's rating.

title: Regularization Term
text: The regularization term added to the objective function is \( \lambda(\hat{\theta}_1+\hat{\theta}_2) \). This is an L1 regularization term, which encourages sparsity in the coefficients.

title: Effect of L1 Regularization
text: L1 regularization can lead to some coefficients being exactly zero, effectively selecting a simpler model by removing some features.

title: Evaluating Statements
text: Consider the effect of L1 regularization on the coefficients \( \hat{\theta}_1 \) and \( \hat{\theta}_2 \). Does it encourage sparsity?
